## About
John J. Goehle is an author, speaker, and pulpit supply pastor. This site is the home of his memoir The Tug (available on Amazon in Kindle, paperback, and hardcover), its two free companion study guides for book clubs and small groups, and his speaking availability for churches, retreats, and community events.
